desc:
🚁 RotorOps, the most advanced emergency helicopter simulator on Roblox: SMUR, fires, gendarmerie, one crew at a time. 

🚑 EMERgency 
EC145, AS365, EC135, H145: winch, stretcher bearers, navigation lights, sliding doors.

🩺 CARE REALLY MATTERS 
Approach the victim, open his medical file, take out the equipment he needs: cervical collar, splint, tourniquet, intubation probe, respirator. Every action counts. He won't go up until everything is done.

🔥 FIRE FIGHTING 
A fire that spreads under the wind, house by house. Bambi bucket, water drop, in-flight refuelling on the CL-415, Dash 8 bomber. Contain the front before it crosses the line.

👮 Gendarmerie 
FLIR thermal camera, night vision binoculars. Monitor a gathering, locate a missing person, stay in touch from the sky.

👥 IN TEAM 
One pilot, two medics - or an entire squadron on a fire. Request to embark, share the mission and the bonus. Playing with friends pays off
